destinations.name: Kenya
destinations.summary: The Masai Mara, Amboseli, Diani and remarkable private conservancies.

destinations.name: Tanzania
destinations.summary: The Serengeti, Ngorongoro and Zanzibar in one extraordinary journey.

destinations.name: Zanzibar
destinations.summary: Spice-island culture, turquoise water and beautifully private stays.

hotels.title: Mara Horizon Tented Camp
hotels.summary: Glass-fronted tented suites overlooking the Mara, with full-board dining and guided game drives.
hotels.description: An intimate luxury camp close to the wildlife corridors of the Masai Mara, with spacious suites, private decks and attentive hosting.

hotels.title: Acacia Ridge Safari Lodge
hotels.summary: A sophisticated Serengeti lodge pairing an infinity pool and spa with uninterrupted plains views.
hotels.description: Contemporary suites combine serene interiors with easy access to exceptional Serengeti wildlife areas.

hotels.title: Cliffside Ocean Retreat
hotels.summary: An ocean-facing retreat with airy suites and the powder-soft sands of Diani close at hand.
hotels.description: A calm coastal hideaway designed around panoramic Indian Ocean views and warm Kenyan hospitality.

hotels.title: The Palms Beach Villas
hotels.summary: Private-pool villas, attentive service and barefoot luxury on a quiet Zanzibar beach.
hotels.description: A secluded villa stay shaped for privacy, romance and effortless access to turquoise water.

hotels.title: Baobab Savannah Camp
hotels.summary: A welcoming family camp with canvas suites and Kilimanjaro on the horizon.
hotels.description: A relaxed multigenerational stay with comfortable tents and engaging junior-ranger activities.

hotels.title: Coral Cove Resort & Spa
hotels.summary: A full-service island resort with lagoon access, wellness and spacious suites.
hotels.description: Swahili-inspired architecture, tropical gardens, water sports and flexible dining in one seamless stay.

safaris.title: Masai Mara Migration Expedition
safaris.summary: Follow the Great Migration with private guiding, dawn drives and golden-hour sundowners.
safaris.description: Seven days in Kenya's flagship reserve timed to the Migration.

safaris.title: Serengeti Endless Plains Classic
safaris.summary: Big-cat country, tented luxury and a finale on the Ngorongoro crater rim.

safaris.title: Amboseli & Kilimanjaro Views
safaris.summary: Elephant herds beneath Kilimanjaro on a gentle, family-friendly safari.
safaris.description: A short escape to Amboseli's elephant country.

safaris.title: Diani Beach & Bush Combo
safaris.summary: Safari thrills followed by barefoot luxury on powder-white Diani Beach.
safaris.description: A seamless Tsavo and coast combination.

safaris.title: Zanzibar Spice Island Escape
safaris.summary: Stone Town, spice farms and an adults-only beach escape.
safaris.description: A romantic island circuit from Stone Town to Nungwi.

safaris.title: Balloon & Big Five Luxury
safaris.summary: A champagne balloon flight and private Big Five safari in style.
safaris.description: An ultra-luxury Mara fly-in for travellers short on time.
